fact: At the African Civil Registration Day event of 12 August 2025, NISR said about 10% of births and 54% of deaths each year go unregistered, and the Secretary of State at MINALOC said all civil registers are now electronic, with births and deaths registered at health facilities and cells.
title: Abana bangana na 10% bavuka buri mwaka ntibandikwa mu irangamimerere
